walkthroughs.body_html:
Unit 1: Speaking — a core area of A-Level Spanish.

Working through it builds the schema you need: the key terms, how they connect, and how to use them together.

Unit 1: Speaking brings together several ideas you need to use as a set, not in isolation.

Lock in the vocabulary first, then practise pulling the ideas together to answer real questions.

Use the activities in this adventure to build familiarity with Unit 1: Speaking.

Practise vocabulary, calculations and free-text questions to lock in the learning.

mcqs.q: Which is the correct reflexive: '___ casé en 2020'?
options: me
se
te
nos

mcqs.q: When was same-sex marriage legalised in Spain?
Where do most descriptive adjectives go relative to the noun?
options: After the noun: 'la casa BLANCA'.
Voy comiendo.
Either position with the same meaning.
Before the noun, as in English.

mcqs.q: How do you say 'I am going to eat' in Spanish (near future)?
options: Habla.
Voy comiendo.
Voy comer.
Voy a comer.

mcqs.q: What is the 'nosotros' form of 'hablar' (to speak)?
options: Habla.
Either position with the same meaning.
Hablan.
Hablamos.
